title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Ampitheatre on 1982-07-27
source: flac16 ; Recorded By Mason Taylor on a Nakamichi 550 Cassette Deck, on chrome tapes; Senn 441's>Sony D5>Mason's Nak 550: Transferred on Mason's restored Nak550 properly

ai_review.summary: Strong second set with a smoking Wheel > The Other One and improving sound quality as the night progresses
ai_review.review: Reviewers note that the recording clears up around Peggy‑O and really shines in the second set, delivering an “awesome trippy” vibe. The Wheel > Other One is highlighted as off‑the‑charts, while the overall mix is described as an outstanding presentation for both head and ears despite a weaker first half.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised (high energy, standout Wheel > Other One) while recording quality improves mid‑show; weighted average yields ~3.9 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound becomes clearer around Peggy‑O; early portion a bit muddy, but overall mix is praised as outstanding for listening.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set starts rough but improves around Peggy‑O; second set maintains high groove and dynamics, delivering a strong musical ride.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's bass drives The Other One to the point of no return, described as “knocking off loose rocks.”
